caveat: Evidence-graded reference scenario based on the NASA Black Brant IX class. It is not a reconstruction of a historical NASA flight and does not claim flight-equivalent fidelity.

sources.title: Sounding Rockets User Handbook, Appendix A.4
sources.rights: NASA public technical publication; U.S. Government work

evidence.formula: constant-thrust plateau normalized to the published average thrust and action time; endpoints include the implicit zero-thrust start and explicit burnout sample
metres = inches * 0.0254; kilograms = pounds * 0.45359237; newtons = pounds-force * 4.4482216153

evidence.impact: The public handbook section specifies Terrier geometry but not a complete thrust curve or loaded mass. The bounded reference curve affects trajectory magnitude and timing and must not be treated as flight prediction.
Public class-level data does not close every structural mass or fin dimension. These values primarily affect rigid-body response, stability, and visual proportions.
Constant aerodynamic coefficients and a generic recovery system are used to produce a deterministic review trace, not a validated flight reconstruction.
